The result is a tuple of two tuples each containing a SMILES string. So two possible precursors? Actually each inner tuple is a set of precursors (maybe single precursor). The output format required: list of lists where each inner list contains SMILES strings of precursors. So we need to format as e.g., [["SMILES1"], ["SMILES2"]].

The two SMILES strings are:

1. CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CC(=O)N(c2c(F)c([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1S(=O)(=O)Nc1ccccc1F

2. CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2c(F)c([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)C(=O)C1S(=O)(=O)Nc1ccccc1F

We need to output list of lists: [["SMILES1"], ["SMILES2"]].

Make sure quoting exactly as required, double quotes inside outer list.

Thus final answer.
